name: Mercenary Biting Chill
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Biting Chill (players/sorcerer/mercenary/biting_chill_merc.sval, 14 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): slow 30% (40%); freeze 2 s (2.25 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Your skills slow by 30% for 4 s and have a 7.5% chance to freeze for 2 s.
